title: wg: targeted-messages-01 editorial fixes (7 items)
description:
Editorial findings in draft-ietf-mls-targeted-messages (targeted-messages-01). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-targeted-messages at ae3ab52.

1. L125 (4 Cryptographic Algorithms; 6.3 Sender Data Encryption): KEM, KDF and AEAD are used at line 125 without expansion and are expanded only later, at lines 299-303. Fix: Expand them at first use in Section 4 and drop the later expansions in Section 6.3.
2. L218 (6.2 Application Data Encryption; 8.3 Message Field Binding; Change Log): The same HPKE input is called "HPKE context"/`hpke_context` (lines 218, 241) and HPKE `info` (lines 421, 679). In RFC 9180, the parameter of SealPSK/OpenPSK is `info`, and "context" names the encryption context, so the current wording invites confusion. Fix: Use `info` throughout, e.g. "The HPKE `info` is a serialized `TargetedMessageContext` struct", and rename `hpke_context` to `hpke_info` in the text and pseudocode.
3. L297 (6.3 Sender Data Encryption; 8.5 Sender Identity Confidentiality): RFC 9420 Section 6.3.2 has no struct named `MLSSenderData`; the struct is `SenderData`. The same wrong name appears again at line 471. Published -01 has the same text. Fix: Replace `MLSSenderData` with `SenderData` at lines 297 and 471.
4. L375 (7.1 Messages from Past Epochs): Comma splice: two independent clauses are joined by a comma. Published -01 has the same text. Fix: "Support for past epochs is OPTIONAL; accepting only the current epoch is the most conservative behavior."
5. L377 (7.1 Messages from Past Epochs; 8.1 Authentication; 8.4 Forward Secrecy): "Forward Secrecy"/"Post-Compromise Security" are capitalized in running text at lines 377 and 401 but lowercase at lines 454, 457 and 459. Fix: Use lowercase in running text and keep capitals only in section titles.
6. L539 (Appendix A Test Vectors): "MTI" is never expanded. Published -01 has the same text. Fix: "All vectors use the mandatory-to-implement (MTI) MLS cipher suite".
7. L712 (Acknowledgments): The Acknowledgments section is empty and renders as an empty section. Published -01 is also empty. Fix: Add acknowledgments or remove the section.

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21), verified per item. Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
close_reason: 2026-10-21: sent as https://github.com/mlswg/mls-targeted-messages/pull/13. 6 of 7 applied; skipped the empty Acknowledgments (editors' call).
